purpose: Line-level provenance for three agent-engineering units distilled from Ascend NPU multi-agent coordination, remote container patch/verification, and stagnation-triggered RSI exploration.
read_method: Manual file inspection at the recorded revisions. No model calls, no remote writes, no NPU execution.

requested_references.resolution: The inspected cannbot-skills revision has no top-level skills/ tree. The closest direct evolution-loop contracts were read from plugins-community/ops-perf-evolution and the MindIE Agent Codex skill snapshot. Their claims are cited below instead of claiming the requested file was read.

The inspected cannbot-skills revision has no skills/tool-git-pr-workflow path. PR text/readback and worktree discipline were read from infra/gitcode-pr-handler and plugins-community/collaborative-agent-kernel-evolution/skills/git-version-management.

assertions: The A3 platform is two Ascend910B dies in one package, not a separate single-die family.
CANN build selection still follows the Ascend910B family with the c220 build mode and arch22.
Per-package compute is described as two dies; per-die values must not be treated as per-package values.
An A3 standing cluster is described as 8 logical NPUs x 2 dies, with die-level Phy-ID values 0..15.
The same contract requires isolated sandbox paths such as /tmp/mindie-bench-* and non-destructive npu-smi probes so active jobs are not disturbed.
The contract therefore distinguishes the logical NPU namespace from the die-level Phy-ID namespace.
redactions: The cited range also contains cluster host addresses; those addresses are omitted from this record and from every unit body.

assertions: ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES selects zero-indexed physical card numbers.
After the environment variable is set, the process-visible npu:0 is a logical device number, not necessarily physical card 0.
The environment variable determines the mapping from logical device number to physical card.
MASTER_PORT=29500 is the torchrun rendezvous default.
Framework deployments may use MASTER_PORT=6038 or 6138 and HCCL_IF_BASE_PORT=23456.
Mixed deployment must ensure these rendezvous ports do not conflict with other services on the same host.
The remote-development configuration has a device_isolate field explicitly mapped to ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES for shared Docker servers.
Docker and hdspace backends differ in persistence and device exclusivity; exclusive access must not be inferred from the backend name.
The workflow requires a target, container, workdir, SOC, and optional CANN path before remote execution.
Any performance benchmark, attribution check, or profiler collection on the same physical NPU or the same A3 dual-die package must acquire an exclusive coordinator timing lease.
The next run must drain /proc process trees before it starts.
This is an explicit mutual-exclusion contract, not an advisory preference.
Each parallel variant is created as a separate git worktree with its own branch.
A worktree has its own .git file pointing at that branch, so commits from the worktree stay on the variant branch.
git -C with a realpath guard is required; relying on shell cwd can commit into the parent repository.
The parent repository must not use git add -A to commit worktree files.
Only successful stages are committed; failed stages remain at the last successful state.
The documented loop is: edit locally, sync to the remote target, build remotely, test or run remotely, pull results, then analyze locally.
Remote sync can be scoped to specific paths instead of the whole repository.
Worktrees are created locally; remote sync takes an explicit worktree path so remote copies land in isolated .worktrees/<name>/ paths.
Commit timing remains local; remote execution does not change branch ownership.
PR title and body content must be regenerated from the actual changed files, diff, and commits; features or platforms without code evidence must not be described.
A PATCH request returning HTTP 200 does not prove the write took effect; the PR must be read back with GET.
No test or debug comments may be sent to the target repository.
All layered execution paths enforce outer_timeout >= sum(inner_budgets) + cleanup_grace.
The local verifier reserves INVENTORY_GRACE_SEC = 10.0 so terminate_tree and inventory can run after an inner timeout.
The remote worker outer deadline is the request timeout plus 10 seconds, reserving SIGTERM, a 2-second drain, SIGKILL, and pipe flush.
The host SSH transport timeout is set above the remote worker outer timeout so the structured JSON receipt is not truncated.
Terminal states are strictly separated into completed_pass, completed_fail, infra_failed, and unknown.
unknown is reserved for indeterminate post-execution state, such as failed workspace inventory, failed oracle restoration, or surviving residual processes.
infra_failed and unknown are reported separately and never folded into completed_fail or dropped from denominator reporting.
Scoring uses only valid terminal outcomes: completed_pass plus completed_fail.
The timeout hierarchy is an explicit wall-clock deadline contract that kills the entire child process group or Windows Job Object before draining pipes.
unknown receipts are reserved for uncertain remote execution.
A local receipt write failure must never turn a succeeded remote call into an error, and must not brick local state into a permanent fault.
The stagnation gate triggers after three consecutive unimproved attempts, deduplicated by run_id, with no new fact or identified divergent layer.
Native de-biased exploration calls knowledge_query with mode=explore, native_subcontext=true, ledger_entries, bottleneck_summary, and goal.
The returned pack strips L3 workflows, keeps L1 foundations, and exposes exploration_context.subagent_fact_pack.

A fresh subagent must be seeded only with subagent_fact_pack.prompt_brief containing L1 hard constraints, L2 bottleneck evidence, L4 mutators, and conditional_avoid; the prior L3 trajectory is removed.
Real isolation requires schema_version mindie-rsi-subagent-pack/1 and inspectable stripped_l3_ids; native_subcontext=false is only an in-session warning.
The stagnation gate is repeated with the same three-unimproved-attempt threshold and the same no-new-fact/no-divergent-layer condition.
PROGRESS.md must be atomically updated with in_flight_runs immediately after launch; a submitted run_id is never replaced.
On resume or compaction, the original run must be queried first; a new execution must not replace an active or uncertain run.
The experiment ledger records hypothesis, factors and factor roles, unit refs, receipt refs, run status, judgment, scope conditions, conditional_avoid, and supersedes_exp_id.
Compile errors, SSH drops, and invalid measurement windows are inconclusive, never domain refuted.
Contract C4: a leave-one-out delta within tolerance only marks candidate_for_sequential_pruning; with pruned_combination_verified=false the factor must be retained.
Only sequential one-at-a-time pruning runs whose final combination passes correctness_verified and performance_verified can prune; L4 distillation requires a baseline_run_id and verification_run_id.
Hidden retention re-runs the final retained combination on frozen hidden inputs.
Each item is classified as both_pass, opt_regression, both_fail, opt_improvement, or evaluation_error.
Only comparable both_pass items enter a speedup ratio.
Guard workloads include alignment, unaligned tail, tile-boundary crossing, workspace high-water mark, graph capture/replay stability, and warm-server repeated call.
A local gain never overrides a guard regression.
Performance analysis starts with Phase 0 subgraph fusion analysis rather than tuning isolated operator microstages.
Fusable producer-consumer links and hard non-fusable boundaries must be identified, and exposed critical-path overlap checked.
Missing durations remain unknown; isolated kernel savings are not added into an end-to-end gain.
A pre-built qualification gate ladder G0-G3 is preferred over ad-hoc build or timing scripts.
TileLang degeneration detected for three consecutive times terminates the evolution loop.
Ops repository build failure for three or more times pauses the loop for user escalation.
The world-model state may not be manually reset or bypassed.
The evolution loop is authorized to explore but must produce compilable code, not analysis alone.
state.json is a runtime cursor separate from world_model.json; re-entry reads the cursor first and resumes from its stage.
The stop hook validates state and artifacts and must be repaired rather than bypassed.
A stagnation window is an explicit parameter; the default formula keeps the window below max_rounds so stagnation can trigger before the round cap.
Local Refinement has its own stagnation window defaulting to two rounds.
The session records a parallel operator/framework split, fast pre-model reproducers, background builds, service-readiness checks, and staged topology expansion.
It records explicit refusal to merge unverified subagent work, explicit reservation of another agent's host, and exact-commit/hash readback before distribution.
It is a redacted digest, not raw logs and not a controlled trial.
The operator work was split across parallel operator validation and an independent framework-review subagent.
The session distinguished framework tests that passed from outcomes still requiring real-machine full-network confirmation.
Fast per-operator and per-layer reproducers ran before loading a very large single-machine model weight set.
The 16-expert, 93-layer small model was used as a cheaper precursor to the main multi-machine model.
Long kernel compilation continued in parallel while independent fast tests were executed.
A started process was not treated as a healthy service; health check and first request were required.
The team switched from single-machine to multi-machine only after recording the remaining blockers, and kept operator packaging parallel.
A draft PR was created while full-network acceptance was explicitly marked incomplete.
PR CI was not treated as acceptance evidence; service readiness and accuracy tests remained separate.
A review correction required reusing the existing attention backend and CANN-provided operators instead of adding a parallel adapter/backend system.
The corrected change was pushed to an exact commit and the diff was the review surface.
An interrupted subagent left an independent worktree with unmerged changes; the parent explicitly refused to merge or deploy it.
Another agent's assigned host was treated as reserved and not touched.
Profiling artifacts were kept under a run-specific path.
The first blocking failure was isolated to the first HCCL PP P2P link, before request processing or DSpark replay.
A two-node, 16-expert, 93-layer minimal reproducer was used to isolate the failure.
Expansion to a larger topology was refused until 4P+4D passed; a later success was recorded with exact source revisions and file hashes.
The verified 4P+4D baseline was distributed to the cluster and the private PR was updated with launch scripts, image IDs, configuration, and reproduction steps.
Rejected static-kernel work was explicitly excluded from the distributed baseline.
Historical EP32 and EP64 configs were kept separate rather than blended into one claim.

redactions: The digest contains redacted and some raw host, credential, user, and path fields. No such value is copied into this record or into a unit body; assertions are paraphrased.

claims.statement: Device, port, worktree, and /tmp state allocation must be acquired as one lease; a check-then-bind sequence is racy on a shared cluster.
claims.scope: Ascend A2/A3 shared container clusters; prescriptive contract, not a measured collision rate.

claims.statement: On an A3 dual-die package the 16 die-level Phy-ID values and the 8 logical NPUs are different namespaces and must be resolved before container device binding.
claims.scope: A3 910C dual-die packages; the exact per-host mapping must be re-inventoried rather than assumed from this contract.

claims.statement: A remote NPU patch should be isolated in a worktree, synced as a minimal diff, and exercised by fast operator/layer reproducers before full model startup.
claims.scope: Recorded live NPU session; the digest is redacted and is not an independently controlled trial.

claims.statement: Long builds and benchmarks need nested timeout budgets and a three-valued external-effect classification; exit status alone is not completion.
claims.scope: Prescriptive contract plus recorded usage; no universal latency or success-rate claim.

claims.statement: Three consecutive unimproved trials with no new fact should freeze the ledger and move the search into a fresh native subcontext that keeps L1/L2/L4 evidence and conditional_avoid but strips prior L3 workflows.
claims.scope: MindIE Agent RSI exploration and CANNBot evolution-loop contracts; not an efficacy trial of exploration.

claims.statement: A stagnation-triggered candidate must pass compile, hidden-input five-category retention, profiler-backed speedup, and Contract C4 sequential ablation before it is distilled as an improvement.
claims.scope: Prescriptive gate contract; no candidate in this distillation was executed against the gates.

privacy.rule: No internal IPs, usernames, user home directories, credentials, container passwords, or customer identifiers may appear in units or evidence.
redactions_applied: Cluster host addresses from the A3 standing-cluster contract are omitted.
The transcript digest is paraphrased; no raw host, credential, user, or workspace path is copied.
Repository locators use public or repository-relative identifiers, not SSH user/host strings.

limitations: The two requested CANNBot paths were not present at the inspected revision; the closest available evolution-loop, PR, worktree, and remote-development contracts were used and are explicitly named.
The offline transcript is a redacted session digest, not raw logs or an independently controlled reproduction. It supports procedural observations, not a measured speedup.
The L1 and L3 units are software-contract rules. They do not establish collision frequency, hardware behavior on every A3 SKU, or exploration efficacy.
The L2 unit is marked reproduced_empirical because the loop appears repeatedly in the recorded live session; this is not a formal controlled trial.
The exact A3 Phy-ID-to-logical mapping must be re-inventoried on each host; this record establishes the namespaces and the requirement to resolve them, not a universal fixed mapping.
No performance claim is made by any unit or by this evidence record.
